description: This dashboard tracks IP overlap risk and diversity health across the fleet. It helps protect isolation quality and identify concentration problems early.

panels.description: This panel compares server-level performance or risk contribution in the selected period. It helps focus intervention on the server groups creating the largest operational impact.

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.captured_at,
    s.last_ip,
    s.proxy_status_scope
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND $__timeFilter(s.captured_at)
    AND (
      '${duplicate_ip:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM JSON_TABLE(
          CAST('${duplicate_ip:json}' AS JSON),
          '$[*]' COLUMNS (ip VARCHAR(64) PATH '$')
        ) AS dup_ip
        WHERE dup_ip.ip = s.last_ip
      )
    )
    AND (
      '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers sf
        WHERE sf.captured_at = s.captured_at
          AND sf.proxy_status_scope = s.proxy_status_scope
          AND sf.last_ip = s.last_ip
          AND sf.server_label IN ($server_name)
      )
    )
)
SELECT
  b.captured_at,
  b.last_ip,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) AS server_count,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) > 1 THEN 'cross-server'
    ELSE 'same-server-only'
  END AS dup_scope,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.server_label ORDER BY s.server_label SEPARATOR ', ') AS servers,
  MAX(x.sibling_phones) AS phones_on_this_ip
FROM base b
INNER JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  ON s.captured_at = b.captured_at
  AND s.proxy_status_scope = b.proxy_status_scope
  AND s.last_ip = b.last_ip
INNER JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
  ON x.captured_at = b.captured_at
  AND x.proxy_status_scope = b.proxy_status_scope
  AND x.last_ip = b.last_ip
GROUP BY b.captured_at, b.last_ip
ORDER BY b.captured_at DESC, dup_scope DESC, b.last_ip
LIMIT 800

panels.title: Snapshot details

panels.description: This panel shows ip ↔ server (latest update) for the selected scope and period. It supports faster, evidence-based operational decisions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.captured_at),
    '-',
    REPLACE(REPLACE(s.last_ip, ':', '_'), '.', '_'),
    '-',
    s.server_label
  ) AS id,
  CONCAT('ip:', s.last_ip) AS `source`,
  CONCAT('srv:', s.server_label) AS `target`,
  s.last_ip AS mainstat,
  ELT(
    1 + (ABS(CRC32(s.last_ip)) MOD 12),
    '#5B8FF9',
    '#61DDAA',
    '#65789B',
    '#F6BD16',
    '#7262FD',
    '#78D3F8',
    '#9661BC',
    '#F6903D',
    '#008685',
    '#F08BB4',
    '#9E87FF',
    '#58D5FF'
  ) AS color,
  2 AS thickness
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
  AND s.captured_at = (
    SELECT MAX(x.captured_at)
    FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers x
    WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
      AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
      AND (
        '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
        OR x.server_label IN ($server_name)
      )
  )
  AND (
    '${duplicate_ip:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM JSON_TABLE(
        CAST('${duplicate_ip:json}' AS JSON),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (ip VARCHAR(64) PATH '$')
      ) AS dup_ip
      WHERE dup_ip.ip = s.last_ip
    )
  )
  AND (
    '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR s.server_label IN ($server_name)
  )
ORDER BY s.last_ip, s.server_label
LIMIT 4000

WITH ip_nodes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CONCAT('ip:', s.last_ip) AS id,
    s.last_ip AS title,
    'IP' AS subtitle,
    '#2563EB' AS color,
    46 AS nodeRadius
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND s.captured_at = (
      SELECT MAX(x.captured_at)
      FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers x
      WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
        AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
        AND (
          '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
          OR x.server_label IN ($server_name)
        )
    )
    AND (
      '${duplicate_ip:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM JSON_TABLE(
          CAST('${duplicate_ip:json}' AS JSON),
          '$[*]' COLUMNS (ip VARCHAR(64) PATH '$')
        ) AS dup_ip
        WHERE dup_ip.ip = s.last_ip
      )
    )
  AND (
    '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR s.server_label IN ($server_name)
  )
),
srv_nodes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CONCAT('srv:', s.server_label) AS id,
    s.server_label AS title,
    'server' AS subtitle,
    '#C2410C' AS color,
    40 AS nodeRadius
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND s.captured_at = (
      SELECT MAX(x.captured_at)
      FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers x
      WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
        AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
        AND (
          '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
          OR x.server_label IN ($server_name)
        )
    )
    AND (
      '${duplicate_ip:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM JSON_TABLE(
          CAST('${duplicate_ip:json}' AS JSON),
          '$[*]' COLUMNS (ip VARCHAR(64) PATH '$')
        ) AS dup_ip
        WHERE dup_ip.ip = s.last_ip
      )
    )
  AND (
    '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR s.server_label IN ($server_name)
  )
),
all_nodes AS (
  SELECT * FROM ip_nodes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM srv_nodes
)
SELECT * FROM all_nodes
UNION ALL
SELECT
  '__nodata__' AS id,
  'No data in range' AS title,
  '' AS subtitle,
  '#94a3b8' AS color,
  36 AS nodeRadius
FROM DUAL
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_nodes) = 0
